title: Number of true bits
statement: For a list of Booleans, define its population count recursively: the empty list has count $0$, and a list with first bit $b$ and remaining list $bs$ has count $(1	ext{ if }b	ext{ is true, otherwise }0)$ plus the count of $bs$.
